## Flow


Detect where the changes will take place (UISERVERDB):
- 1.  Identify where the new screen will be located in the GUI (i.e. from where the user with interact with it) - usually will be provided by documentation (BAs, TSD, etc.) and try to connect/group the new screen with the already existing ones
- 2.  Identify the child module of the server component that is going to be affected (in the existing screens Inspect element > Network > find the Request URL to the server component)
- 3.  examine if update to existing tables is required as well



Make changes is the code (DBSERVERUI):
- 1.  pwc-db: update data model
- 2.  pwc-server: update childModule.btdesing
- 3.  pwc-ui: create new screen - try to find a similar screen for copy paste, ctrl+F is your friend (70% investigation 30% implementation)

Edit files execute.bat and config.properties. Export the scripts in the pwc-db/Installation/Patch/BO/Dev_DB_Repository folder with the following command. When asked, input the absolute path of the config.properties file.


```
java -jar ExtractDDL_devOps_02.jar

```

# Changes in pwc-server module


## Package generate_dsl_2 => generate server (btdesign) entities

Oracle SQL Develop > Open your local database > Packages > Apply Filter > Input package name: generate_dsl_2 > Double Click > Run (green button) > PROCEDURE_NAME> P_TABLE_NAME Input Value: table name > click OK > copy from log > paste the code in the relevant .btdesign file


## Package GENERATE_DSL_JPUB2 => jpublisher entities (packages)

Oracle SQL Develop > Open your local database > Packages > Apply Filter > Input package name: GENERATE_DSL_JPUB2 > Double Click > Run (green button) > PROCEDURE_NAME> P_PACKAGE_NAME Input Value: package name > click OK > copy from log > paste the code in the relevant . btdesign file

The generated code may need extra modifications. For example, only one foreign key should be declared in each entity. Usually this fk is the bank code:


```
- @Bank fk_bank_code key hint = "BaseColumn1=bank_code" fetch = "lazy";
```


## Build

```
- @Bank fk_bank_code key hint = "BaseColumn1=bank_code" fetch = "lazy";
```


## Build

From pwc-server/v3_31-parent/pom.xml comment out all modules except the child module in which you performed the changes AND the module (at v3_31 <modules></modules>), save and build the parent (mvn clean install -Dmaven.test.skip=true)

Build again with all the modules (w/o clean: mvn install -Dmaven.test.skip=true)

OR

Build only the module with the changes AND the module (mvn clean install -Dmaven.test.skip=true) v3_31

Find v3_31web.war > right click > 7-Zip > Open archive > go to WEB-INF/lib/ > drag and drop the new jars > save

Finally, deploy the newly created pwc-server/v3_31-web/target/v3_31-web.war to JBOSS

Read carefully the document Sculptor generator!!!


## Commit

Commit only the changes you did manually (i.e. the .btdesign you changed) and NOT all the generated files of the build.

## For faster build

Comment out modules to minimize the modules that the app will serve. When we try to access them from the ui, we will get a 404 not found. When we want to create a new screen, we can comment out everything else.


- src\app\core\route\core.routes.ts (e.g. comment: admin)
- src\app\operation\operation.module.ts (e.g. comment: acquiring, switch, atm, xpos, fraud)
- src\app\operation\issuing\issuing.routes.ts (e.g. comment all except: boarding and client)
- src\app\parameters\parameters.module.ts (e.g. comment: acquiring, atm, xpos, fraud, general, switch)
- src\app\parameters\issuing\issuing.routes.ts (e.g. comment all except: catalogue and delivery-method)


BUILD: the 1st time by running the command node --max_old_space_size=4096 ./node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng serve

REBUILD: each time you save the changes you made in some file (VSCode has the option: File > Save All)

(Do not commit the changes with the comments!)

```

For files 1-14, download files from the template (new-screen.rar) in your local environment, copy the extracted folder to the appropriate path and replace the new-screen and newScreen instances with your screen's name. Clean the code by removing the unusable parts, i.e. the parts that are not required for the screen you want to develop (not used PopUp, not used functions, commented code, generated functions refering to the old generator version, etc). Edit the remaining files to suit the new screen needs (entities and fields as defined in server and db, validation, general formatting of the screen, etc).


## DETAILS/COMMENTS

- 1-2.. required for running the unit tests. UT are written using Jasmine Behavior-Driven syntax. The tests are run using KARMA test runner.
- 1.... Lambda Details screen test should: create Lambda detail component, contain details HTML elements, fill fields based on mocked service (setValues())
- 2.... Lambda Search screen test should: create the Lambda component, contain search HTML elements, search for elements, should go to details
- 3-9.. The layout of the two main views (search and details). They both consist of: Screen title, Header Div, Footer Div, Action bar with grants & event, Criteria div reffering to an external component
- 3.... Detail fields can be ordered in one or several tabs, splited in sub components for big screens.
- 4.... beforeSave() is called on save action and can be overwritten. Remove .clone(this.context.entity) from beforeSave function.
- 5-6.. edit these files when popups are required in your screen
- 7-8.. a reusable part of the new screen, that is going to be used in the default (search) view AND in the details view
- 9.... Datatable is the results table, with raised events on actions. Add : [ref]="context?.ref"  to <pwc-datatable ..> for labelRefColumns.

- 9.... Datatable is the results table, with raised events on actions. Add : [ref]="context?.ref"  to <pwc-datatable ..> for labelRefColumns.
- 10... The buildColumns() builds the columns of the results table (Builds columns with several types: date, string, amount, custom through label functions…) The search() function can be overwritten.

For the buildColumns() some of the available options are:
- pushColumn
- addLabelRefColumn (same with pushColumn, used for dropdowns lists, Sara prefers this one)
- addStringColumn
- addTypeColumn
- addLabelColumn
- addStaticListColumn
- 11... data value object declaration. Input fields as defined in the dto of the relevant entity in the .btdesign file of the pwc-server component (the fields correspond to the data model table). Careful when there are Sets (sets in btdesign refers to 1 to N relation in db), each set must be defined as a new entity!
- 12... adjust config file. Add the references and lists needed.
- SCREEN: 'screen-name'  name of screen as in the screen url (pwc-ui)
- MODULE: 'childModule'  name of child module (pwc-server)
- SERVICE: 'Screen_name'  name of service used (pwc-server)
- SEARCH_PARAM_REFS: ['Table1', 'View1']  connection/relations with other tables/views for search screen (pwc-db)
- SEARCH_STATIC_LISTS: ['List1', 'List2']  for radio buttons/dropdowns/... of search screen. Gets lists from STATIC_LIST table (pwc-db)

- DETAILS_PARAM_REFS: []  same with SEARCH_PARAM_REFS, but for details screen
- DETAILS_STATIC_LISTS: []  same with SEARCH_STATIC_LISTS, but for details screen


The details screen inherits the references and lists of the search screen, so there is no need to add them twice!!!

When using a custom HPS component, be sure to use all the references needed for this specific component, even if they don't appear on your screen!!!

In case of sets in btdesign files, add also:


```
export const FIND_ALL_OTHER_ENTITY = { mod: 'childModule', service: 'Other_entityService', vo: 'other_entityVO', method: 'getAllOther_entityService' };
```

```
export const FIND_ALL_OTHER_ENTITY = { mod: 'childModule', service: 'Other_entityService', vo: 'other_entityVO', method: 'getAllOther_entityService' };
```


- 13... contains info about the screen that will be saved in the database (tables: screen, menu, menus2roles, grant_permission). This file will not be committed in the pwc-ui repo. Apply the changes in your local personal database along with required insertions in the table RESSOURCE_BUNDLE (for all the labels that are going to be used in the gui). After verifying the changes, update the db patch as described in the Changes in pwc-db module section.
- 15... to execute the unit tests, add mock file in assets-tests repository. Insert dummy data.
- 16... Add the module to the issuing.routes.ts file. Required each time a new screen is created. Without this change, you won't be able to access your screen when running the app.

# New Screen


- HPS training material
- Flow
- Changes in pwc-db module

## HPS training material

Please refer to HPS training as well:

PWC_Training_UI_SARA_ALEM_090420.pptx


## Flow


Detect where the changes will take place (UISERVERDB):
- 1.  Identify where the new screen will be located in the GUI (i.e. from where the user with interact with it) - usually will be provided by documentation (BAs, TSD, etc.) and try to connect/group the new screen with the already existing ones
- 2.  Identify the child module of the server component that is going to be affected (in the existing screens Inspect element > Network > find the Request URL to the server component)
- 3.  examine if update to existing tables is required as well



Make changes is the code (DBSERVERUI):
- 1.  pwc-db: update data model
- 2.  pwc-server: update childModule.btdesing
- 3.  pwc-ui: create new screen - try to find a similar screen for copy paste, ctrl+F is your friend (70% investigation 30% implementation)



## Changes in pwc-db module

Update db schema in your local db.


- 000_Sequences
- 001_Before
- 002_Tables
- 003_Indexes
- 004_Constraints_NonFK
- 005_Triggers
- 006_Migration_Scripts
- 007_Constraints_FK
- 008_After
- 009_Types
- 010_Views
- 011_Functions
- 012_Scripts
- 013_Packages
- 015_Multi_langue_init
- 016_Ressource_Bundle
- 017_Compliance
- 018_Static_list



For the changes to be committed, update the contents of the following folders:
- pwc-db/Dev_DB_Repository (add your changes) - to be discussed if changes are going to be saved here too
- pwc-db/Installation/Patch/BO (delete the old contents of pwc-db/Installation/Patch/BO/ folder - EXCEPT the logsDB folder - and add your changes)


Edit files execute.bat and config.properties. Export the scripts in the pwc-db/Installation/Patch/BO/Dev_DB_Repository folder with the following command. When asked, input the absolute path of the config.properties file.


```
java -jar ExtractDDL_devOps_02.jar
```

Then run the following command in order to generate the necessary scripts required for applying the changes. When asked, input the absolute path to the BO folder (e.g. D:\WorkGit\pwc-db\Installation\Patch\BO)

```
java -jar generateDBInstall.jad
```

Commit the generated files. Do NOT commit the generateDBInstall.jad file!!!! The logsDB folder should contain ONLY the log.txt file!!!!


# Changes in pwc-server module


## Package generate_dsl_2 => generate server (btdesign) entities

Oracle SQL Develop > Open your local database > Packages > Apply Filter > Input package name: generate_dsl_2 > Double Click > Run (green button) > PROCEDURE_NAME> P_TABLE_NAME Input Value: table name > click OK > copy from log > paste the code in the relevant .btdesign file


## Package GENERATE_DSL_JPUB2 => jpublisher entities (packages)

Oracle SQL Develop > Open your local database > Packages > Apply Filter > Input package name: GENERATE_DSL_JPUB2 > Double Click > Run (green button) > PROCEDURE_NAME> P_PACKAGE_NAME Input Value: package name > click OK > copy from log > paste the code in the relevant . btdesign file

The generated code may need extra modifications. For example, only one foreign key should be declared in each entity. Usually this fk is the bank code:


```
- @Bank fk_bank_code key hint = "BaseColumn1=bank_code" fetch = "lazy";
```


## Build

From pwc-server/v3_31-parent/pom.xml comment out all modules except the child module in which you performed the changes AND the module (at v3_31 <modules></modules>), save and build the parent (mvn clean install -Dmaven.test.skip=true)

Build again with all the modules (w/o clean: mvn install -Dmaven.test.skip=true)

OR

Build only the module with the changes AND the module (mvn clean install -Dmaven.test.skip=true) v3_31

Find v3_31web.war > right click > 7-Zip > Open archive > go to WEB-INF/lib/ > drag and drop the new jars > save

Finally, deploy the newly created pwc-server/v3_31-web/target/v3_31-web.war to JBOSS

Read carefully the document Sculptor generator!!!


## Commit

Commit only the changes you did manually (i.e. the .btdesign you changed) and NOT all the generated files of the build.


## Changes in pwc-ui module


## For faster build

Comment out modules to minimize the modules that the app will serve. When we try to access them from the ui, we will get a 404 not found. When we want to create a new screen, we can comment out everything else.


- src\app\core\route\core.routes.ts (e.g. comment: admin)
- src\app\operation\operation.module.ts (e.g. comment: acquiring, switch, atm, xpos, fraud)
- src\app\operation\issuing\issuing.routes.ts (e.g. comment all except: boarding and client)
- src\app\parameters\parameters.module.ts (e.g. comment: acquiring, atm, xpos, fraud, general, switch)
- src\app\parameters\issuing\issuing.routes.ts (e.g. comment all except: catalogue and delivery-method)


BUILD: the 1st time by running the command node --max_old_space_size=4096 ./node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng serve

REBUILD: each time you save the changes you made in some file (VSCode has the option: File > Save All)

(Do not commit the changes with the comments!)

# For a new screen the files below are required:


```
NEW FILES FROM GENERATOR (COPY FROM TEMPLATE) tests/newScreen-details.component.spec.ts ...................[1] tests/newScreen.component.spec.ts ...........................[2] view/details/newScreen-details.component.html ...............[3] view/details/newScreen-details.component.ts .................[4] view/popups/newScreen-popup.component.html ..................[5] view/popups/newScreen-popup.component.ts ....................[6] view/newScreen-criterias.component.html .....................[7] view/newScreen-criterias.component.ts .......................[8] view/newScreen.component.html ...............................[9] view/newScreen.component.ts .................................[10] vo/newScreen.entity.ts ......................................[11] newScreen.config.ts .........................................[12] newScreen.db.sql ............................................[13] newScreen.module.ts .........................................[14] TO BE CREATED new-screen.mock.json ........................................[15] TO BE EDITED issuing.routes.ts ...........................................[16] { path: 'new-screen', loadChildren: './product/new-screen/newScreen.module#newScreenModule' },
```

For files 1-14, download files from the template (new-screen.rar) in your local environment, copy the extracted folder to the appropriate path and replace the new-screen and newScreen instances with your screen's name. Clean the code by removing the unusable parts, i.e. the parts that are not required for the screen you want to develop (not used PopUp, not used functions, commented code, generated functions refering to the old generator version, etc). Edit the remaining files to suit the new screen needs (entities and fields as defined in server and db, validation, general formatting of the screen, etc).


## DETAILS/COMMENTS


- 1-2.. required for running the unit tests. UT are written using Jasmine Behavior-Driven syntax. The tests are run using KARMA test runner.
- 1.... Lambda Details screen test should: create Lambda detail component, contain details HTML elements, fill fields based on mocked service (setValues())
- 2.... Lambda Search screen test should: create the Lambda component, contain search HTML elements, search for elements, should go to details
- 3-9.. The layout of the two main views (search and details). They both consist of: Screen title, Header Div, Footer Div, Action bar with grants & event, Criteria div reffering to an external component
- 3.... Detail fields can be ordered in one or several tabs, splited in sub components for big screens.
- 4.... beforeSave() is called on save action and can be overwritten. Remove .clone(this.context.entity) from beforeSave function.
- 5-6.. edit these files when popups are required in your screen
- 7-8.. a reusable part of the new screen, that is going to be used in the default (search) view AND in the details view
- 9.... Datatable is the results table, with raised events on actions. Add : [ref]="context?.ref"  to <pwc-datatable ..> for labelRefColumns.
- 10... The buildColumns() builds the columns of the results table (Builds columns with several types: date, string, amount, custom through label functions…) The search() function can be overwritten.



For the buildColumns() some of the available options are:
- pushColumn
- addLabelRefColumn (same with pushColumn, used for dropdowns lists, Sara prefers this one)
- addStringColumn
- addTypeColumn
- addLabelColumn
- addStaticListColumn
- 11... data value object declaration. Input fields as defined in the dto of the relevant entity in the .btdesign file of the pwc-server component (the fields correspond to the data model table). Careful when there are Sets (sets in btdesign refers to 1 to N relation in db), each set must be defined as a new entity!
- 12... adjust config file. Add the references and lists needed.
- SCREEN: 'screen-name'  name of screen as in the screen url (pwc-ui)
- MODULE: 'childModule'  name of child module (pwc-server)
- SERVICE: 'Screen_name'  name of service used (pwc-server)
- SEARCH_PARAM_REFS: ['Table1', 'View1']  connection/relations with other tables/views for search screen (pwc-db)
- SEARCH_STATIC_LISTS: ['List1', 'List2']  for radio buttons/dropdowns/... of search screen. Gets lists from STATIC_LIST table (pwc-db)

- DETAILS_PARAM_REFS: []  same with SEARCH_PARAM_REFS, but for details screen
- DETAILS_STATIC_LISTS: []  same with SEARCH_STATIC_LISTS, but for details screen


The details screen inherits the references and lists of the search screen, so there is no need to add them twice!!!

When using a custom HPS component, be sure to use all the references needed for this specific component, even if they don't appear on your screen!!!

In case of sets in btdesign files, add also:


```
export const FIND_ALL_OTHER_ENTITY = { mod: 'childModule', service: 'Other_entityService', vo: 'other_entityVO', method: 'getAllOther_entityService' };
```


- 13... contains info about the screen that will be saved in the database (tables: screen, menu, menus2roles, grant_permission). This file will not be committed in the pwc-ui repo. Apply the changes in your local personal database along with required insertions in the table RESSOURCE_BUNDLE (for all the labels that are going to be used in the gui). After verifying the changes, update the db patch as described in the Changes in pwc-db module section.
- 15... to execute the unit tests, add mock file in assets-tests repository. Insert dummy data.
- 16... Add the module to the issuing.routes.ts file. Required each time a new screen is created. Without this change, you won't be able to access your screen when running the app.
